name: brainbox
description: BrainBox 0.1.1: the brain can no longer delete its own job list. In the first real conversation on 0.1.0 it rewrote About me.md around headings of its own, so all eleven questions it still had to ask disappeared with nothing to say so. The headings About me.md ships with are now recorded when the brain is built, and a check names any that go missing. Also fixes a counting fault that printed an error once every blank was answered.
